## Professional Summary
Senior Mobile Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise React Native applications for fintech, banking, media, healthcare, and commerce products serving hundreds of thousands to millions of users.

Proven track record improving application reliability, scalability, and developer productivity by modernizing legacy mobile platforms, designing offline-first architectures, building native iOS and Android modules, and developing cloud-backed mobile solutions with AWS and Firebase.

Strong collaborator who works closely with Product, Design, QA, Security, and Engineering teams. Passionate about AI-driven development (AIDD), automation, and Spec-Driven Development (SDD).

## Skills
Mobile Engineering: React Native, Expo (Managed & Bare), TypeScript, JavaScript, Native iOS (Swift), Native Android (Kotlin/Java), Native Modules, React Native New Architecture (JSI, TurboModules, Fabric)
Cloud & Backend: AWS, Firebase, Google Cloud, GraphQL, REST APIs
Performance & Security: Mobile performance optimization, Secure Storage (Keychain/Keystore), Biometrics, SSL Pinning, Authentication Systems
Delivery & Quality: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, EAS), Jest, Appium, OTA Updates, CodePush, Agile, Code Reviews
State Management: Redux, Zustand, Jotai, Recoil
AI & Modern Engineering: AIDD, LLM Integration, AI Agents, TensorFlow Lite, On-Device AI, Spec-Driven Development (SDD)
Leadership: Technical Leadership, Architecture Ownership, Mentorship, Cross-functional Collaboration
